issues.title_en: Moses Kuria tells CS Ruku not to divide Mt Kenya after attack on Gachagua
issues.summary: Former Trade Cabinet Secretary Moses Kuria has urged Public Service Cabinet Secretary Geoffrey Ruku to avoid deepening political divisions in the Mt Kenya region following his latest criticism of former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua. Kuria’s appeal came after Ruku defended Deputy President Kithure Kindiki against sustained criticism from Gachagua, insisting that the Mt Kenya region [...]
